A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Naes casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Sanctuary|sanctuary]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Antilife Shell|antilife shell]], [[Tools/Spells/Blade Barrier|blade barrier]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Divine Word|divine word]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Heal|mass heal]]

reactions.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
reactions.desc: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

traits.name: Potion Mishap
traits.desc: When Nauk uses the Imbibe Potion action more than once in an hour, roll 1d4 for what happens: • 1. The potion works normally. • 2. The potion works normally. In addition, Nauk turns invisible for 1 minute or until Nauk attacks or casts a spell. • 3. The potion has no effect. • 4. Instead of the normal effect, the potion causes fire to explode out of Nauk's mouth in a 15 foot cone. Nauk and any creature in the cone take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.desc: When Nauk is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can drop to 1 hit point instead. He can't use this feature again for 24 hours

traits.name: Special Items
traits.desc: Nauk wears adamantine plate armor. He wields a +1 maul and a +1 heavy crossbow which is already factored into his stats. He has 2 potions of resistance (cold), 2 potions of resistance (fire), 2 potions of resistance (lightning). He has 2 potions of heroism and 4 potions of superior healing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nauk makes three Magic Maul attacks. Nauk may substitute one of those attacks for the Imbibe Potion action.

actions.name: Magic Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Imbibe Potion
actions.desc: Nauk drinks a potion from the following list: • Potion of heroism: Nauk gains 10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. For the same duration, Nauk is under the effect of the [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]] spell (no concentration required). • Potion of resistance: Nauk gains resistance from one damage type for 1 hour. Nauk chooses from one of these damage types: cold, fire, lightning. • Potion of superior healing: Nauk regains 28 hit points.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Nauk adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Nauk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Pazuzu
sb.damage_immunities: lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Aura of Servile Avians
traits.desc: Any evil creature with a natural fly speed and a CR of 20 or less must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw if they attempt to attack Pazuzu. A failed save means their action is wasted and the attack fails. On a successful saving throw the target is immune to this effect in the future.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Pazuzu's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Pazuzu makes two Greatsword or Talon attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Pazuzu exhales poisonous acid in a 100-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Every creature hit by the acid must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this breath weapon melts and is disintegrated.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Pazuzu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Astral Projection|astral projection]], [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Hallow|hallow]], [[Tools/Spells/Insect Plague|insect plague]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]], [[Tools/Spells/Wind Walk|wind walk]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (only itself and willing creatures)
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Wish|wish]]

bonus_actions.name: Dispel
bonus_actions.desc: Pazuzu casts [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], automatically dispelling any spell of 6th level or lower on the target.

bonus_actions.name: Hasted Greatsword
bonus_actions.desc: Pazuzu uses his magic greatsword to grant him the following abilities until the start of his next turn. Pazuzu's speed is now doubled, he gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and gains one additional Greatsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Disarm

traits.desc: Xzar's infusion with the Chaos Phage gives him the following benefits: • Xzar regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point • Xzar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects • Xzar has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder • Xzar has darkvision and telepathy to 60 feet

traits.desc: When Xzar kills a creature that is neither a Construct nor Undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, Xzar regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times if it is a necromancy spell.

traits.desc: Since Xzar doesn't have a soul, resurrection magic is able to work upon him no matter how much time has passed. For example, the [[Tools/Spells/Revivify|revivify]] spell would work on Xzar even a week after he died. However, spells like true resurrection and wish are unable to bring Xzar back to life if no body exists.

Any creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere around Xzar (but not including Xzar) must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 36 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
